title: The Dollar-Euro Exchange Rate
gist: Teaser: the euro has slipped below US$1.10 for the first time since April 2025; Gavekal calls EUR/USD one of the world's most important prices for investment strategy and warns technicals point to a coming period of violent exchange-rate moves.

insights.claim: The euro fell below US$1.10 in mid-November 2026, its first time below that level since April 2025.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: EUR/USD breaking a level not seen since April 2025 marks a regime shift worth tracking for FX-hedged and European-exposed portfolios.
insights.quote: Over the past week, the euro has fallen below US$1.10 for the first time since April 2025.
insights.locator: Over the past week, the euro

insights.claim: Gavekal Research argues the US dollar and euro have been in an 'ugliness contest' since around the global financial crisis, with neither currency clearly more attractive than the other.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Treat EUR/USD as a relative-weakness trade between two flawed currencies rather than a bet on either one's intrinsic strength.
insights.quote: mired in an ugliness contest since around the time of the global financial crisis
insights.locator: The two major currencies of the Western world

insights.claim: Gavekal Research views the dollar-euro exchange rate as probably one of the most important prices in the world for forming an investment strategy.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: EUR/USD direction should feed into top-down asset allocation decisions, not only currency hedging.
insights.quote: the exchange rate between the two currencies is probably one of the most important prices in the world when it comes to forming an investment strategy

insights.claim: Gavekal Research's technical analysis suggests the dollar-euro exchange rate may be nearing a period of violent movements.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Expect a jump in EUR/USD volatility; consider long-volatility FX options or tighter hedges on euro/dollar exposures.
insights.quote: from a technical perspective, we may be nearing a period of violent exchange rate movements
